usedFor: Aircall is where calls and contacts start, and Dynosend gets each “New Contact” as a contact through “Create a contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in Aircall, then “Create a contact” in Dynosend
bestTemplate.why: People your phone team adds land in an audience in Dynosend without retyping.

watchOut: “Create a contact” adds to a given audience, so choose that audience before you turn the template on.
